title: CyberDefenders Wins 2023 SANS Difference Makers Award – Team of the Year in Cybersecurity
content:
CyberDefenders Wins Prestigious SANS Difference Makers Award 2023 – Team of the Year!
CT
CyberDefenders Team
October 7, 2024
Share this post:
We are beyond excited to announce a monumental achievement for CyberDefenders! Our team has been honored with the prestigious
"SANS Difference Makers Award (DMA) 2023"
in cybersecurity by the SANS Institute. This recognition not only celebrates our efforts in the world of cybersecurity but also acknowledges our relentless dedication to shaping a safer digital landscape for everyone.
The SANS DMA Award: What It Means
The
SANS Difference Makers Award
is one of the most coveted recognitions in the cybersecurity world. Being named
Team of the Year
is not only a testament to the hard work of our entire team but also to the value we bring to the
cybersecurity community
. This award is reserved for organizations that are making significant strides in the fight against cyber threats, and we are immensely proud to be recognized among the top players in the field.
CyberDefenders: A Commitment to Excellence
At CyberDefenders, quality is at the heart of everything we do. From our cutting-edge
Certified Cyber Defender (CCD)
program to our innovative
BlueYard CyberRange
, we are dedicated to providing the best learning and simulation experiences for cybersecurity professionals. Winning this award validates our relentless pursuit of excellence and motivates us to continue raising the bar for our products and services.
Thank You to Our Community
This achievement would not have been possible without
YOU
– our incredible community of learners, partners, and supporters. Your trust and engagement fuel our mission to create impactful cybersecurity training solutions. Your passion, dedication, and drive have been the backbone of our success. Every community member has played a crucial role in helping us reach this point, and this award is a testament to your efforts.
As we celebrate this victory, we look forward to continuing this exciting journey together. The future of cybersecurity is bright, and CyberDefenders is ready to lead the way! Stay tuned for more exciting developments as we continue to grow, innovate, and make a difference in the world of cybersecurity!
